Name: Child Clothing Rework
Author: earthdeep
Description:
Includes redone sprites for all children. 

~Wandering babies no longer have covered feet, and have a proper blanket at night.
~Toddler boys have overalls.
~Toddler girls have jumperskirts.

To install, just extract the files and use them to replace the ones in your Content/Characters folder.  (Make sure you make backups first!)
